properties.headline: Fire Weather Watch issued November 17 at 12:46PM MST until November 18 at 4:00PM MST by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Denver CO has issued a Fire Weather
Watch.

* AFFECTED AREA...Fire Weather Zones 215, 238, 239, 240, and 243.

* TIMING...From Wednesday morning through Wednesday afternoon.

* WINDS...West 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 70-75 mph for the
northern Front Range mountains and foothills. West 20 to 30 mph
with gusts up to 50 mph on the plains.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...Between 10 to 20 percent.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be favorable for rapid fire spread. Avoid
outdoor burning and any activity that may produce a spark and start
a wildfire.
properties.instruction:
If you have not packed your go kit yet, now is the time to do so.
This includes items like important documents and essentials you
cannot live without. Fill your vehicle's fuel tank. Visit
ready.gov/kit for more information.

properties.description: The Fire Weather Watch has been replaced. Please see the latest information from NWS Denver CO on this developing situation.
properties.instruction:
Be sure you are signed up for your local emergency alert system. You
can find this information at dhsem.colorado.gov/emergencyalert.

Follow all fire restrictions. Avoid activities that can cause sparks
and do not park hot vehicles on dry vegetation. One less spark, one
less wildfire.

A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now...or will shortly. A combination of strong
winds...low relative humidity...and warm temperatures can contribute
to extreme fire behavior.
